_comment: FICTIONAL golden expectations for the Milestone 5 adjustment engine, derived INDEPENDENTLY of src/engine/adjustments (which did not exist) from RULES.md, the design v2 contract and the M2 fixtures. Money strings are cents; 'E4' fields are integer ten-thousandths of a dollar (12500 = $1.25). Weights are decimal strings compared numerically. Arrays of sides.lines are informational; assert the fields listed in RULES.md part G. Every number is explained in the derivation notes (scratchpad m5-golden-derivation/README.md).
